subject: literacy
concept: Writing a complete short story combining character development, showing not telling, dialogue, sensory detail, and a resolved ending
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their story using a character/setting/problem/resolution graphic organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes a complete short story applying all narrative craft skills from this unit

assessment.mastery_threshold: story includes a specific character, at least one shown (not told) emotion, punctuated dialogue, sensory setting detail, and a resolved ending
misconception_flags: story includes the required elements individually but they don't connect into a coherent whole

interest_binding: story prompt generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
